Samira (PM): FWIW i'm drafting an "island runway" acceptance checklist for routing + multi-region isolation. Want minimal, testable items we can hand to customers before invites.
Eli (Eng): Nice name. Keep it pragmatic: measurable runtime gates (KV hit %, added hop ms), plus a short compatibility contract for model variants.
Jon (Infra): From infra: placement modes (pin/prefer/any), autoscaler reaction <=60s on 2x spike, egress delta estimate that Sales can show customers. Also need a scheduler enforcement hook for pin.
Priya (SRE): Ops gates: canary cadence (0.5% 24h -> 5% 72h -> 25% week), token-level cost telemetry, regional P95 heatmaps, and a tested rollback path. Tabletop exercise required before GA.
Maya (GTM): Sales wants three lanes in the one-pager: Cloud-shared, Reserved-dedicated, Private-VPC. Each lane needs clear commit levels and a short migration blurb.
Reed (Legal): We'll prepare two snippets: Pilot (no SLA) and Reserved (SLA + credits). Need exact defs for "outage" and "data-residency fallback" to avoid ambiguity.
Samira (PM): Proposed acceptance rows: Tech fit, Infra readiness, Runtime perf, SRE ops, Contracts/GTM. Columns: Pilot / Canary / GA. Each cell = pass/fail check.
Eli (Eng): Tech-fit (Pilot) specifics: KV cache hit >= 80% steady-state, added hop median < 100ms, batching tail < 2x baseline, compatibility tag on model bundles. Plz include a small client-visible header `x-rdl-model-v` so customers can detect switches.
Jon (Infra): Infra (Pilot): scheduler honors soft-prefer, autoscaler <60s for 2x, egress delta < +25% or explicit customer approval, placement webhook prototype ready. I'll run an egress projection across AWS/EU/GC in 10 days.
Priya (SRE): SRE (Pilot): alerts set: P95 delta >20% or error-rate >0.5% triggers rollback. Retention: pilot telemetry 30d. Runbook: local fallback -> alternate region -> mark tenant impacted after 10m grace. Tabletop scheduled.
Maya (GTM): Customer acceptance (Pilot): golden-query validation, signed migration window, and rollback contact. Sales suggests a small pilot credit; Reed pls confirm cap.
Reed (Legal): Credits OK with cap + migration notice clause. For residency fallback we should include opt-in checkbox in onboarding form.
Samira (PM): Unknowns to spike: KV priming cost under churn, model glue-tests across quantized/FP variants, and cross-region serialization overhead. Eli + Jon to own spikes (2w).
Eli (Eng): I'll build a tiny replay harness and run synthetic churn tests to measure KV warmup and batching tails. ETA 2w.
Jon (Infra): I'll prototype the scheduler webhook and egress model; will share numbers early next week.
Priya (SRE): I'll draft canary dashboards and an automated rollback playbook (simulated) by EOD next Fri.
Maya (GTM): I'll draft the one-pager and lane pricing options. Also propose a "migration concierge" for first 2 reserved customers (timeboxed).
Reed (Legal): Concierge OK if timeboxed + scoped with liability caps. I'll draft an exhibit for concierge scope.
BoardBot: Created ticket PLAT-9001 "island-runway-acceptance-checklist" assigned to Samira. Weekly sync Tue 10:00.
Samira (PM): Great. Please post 2-sentence owner plans here by Thu. I'll fold into the roadmap deck and share with execs. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
